name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Compensation Towards Natural Calamities
benefit: - Financial assistance shall be provided to meet expenses towards the repair or construction of a house damaged due to natural calamities. - The quantum of financial assistance shall be a maximum of ₹25,000/- or as per the valuation done by the concerned Taluka Mamlatdar, whichever is less.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a Goan, i.e., born and brought up in Goa. - The applicant must be recognized as an artist by the Directorate of Art & Culture, Government of Goa. - The income of the family of the applicant (from all sources) must not exceed ₹2,00,000/- per annum. - The artist must not be less than 50 years in age. (The Government may relax the age criteria for deserving cases under special circumstances.) - The applicant must be in need of funds to meet expenses towards repair or construction of their house damaged due to natural calamities.
